images.caption: Figure 1:Data construction pipeline.(a) Gemini-3.1-Pro and Seed2.1 pro annotate each video coarse to fine, from a global overview and event outlines to timestamped steps. (b) The draft caption is reviewed against the full video and corrected. (c) Each validated caption can yield full-video, event-conditioned, and overview instructions. (d) Body and camera poses are converted into timed motion facts.

Figure 2:Illustration of the rewards designed for egocentric captioning.Fact, time, and style rewards are combined for step-level captions, while overview captions pair the content reward with a format reward. The content rewardRfactR_{\mathrm{fact}}is the F1 of judge-scored precision and recall over extracted facts, the time rewardRtimeR_{\mathrm{time}}greedily matches predicted and reference steps by temporal IoU, and the style rewardRstyleR_{\mathrm{style}}penalizes steps that judges flag as fragmented or redundant.
Figure 3:Task-focused detail and temporal granularity (RQ3).Each panel shows EgoCaptioner’s timed step descriptions for one activity type, with task-relevant details highlighted.
